title: Present Simple (be, have, do) - Basic forms and statements

explanation.en: Use 'has' with third person singular (she, he, it)

explanation.en: Use 'am' with 'I' and include the article 'a' before singular countable nouns

explanation.en: Use 'do' with plural subjects (they, we) and first person (I)

explanation.uz: Ko‘plikdagi ega (they, we) va birinchi shaxs (I) bilan 'do' ishlatiladi

explanation.en: Use 'is' with third person singular subjects

explanation.en: Use 'have' with plural subjects (we, they) and first person (I)
